en.hubeali:
From him, from Al Sayyari, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ahmad Bin Al Mubarak, from Abu Usman, from Dorost, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The radish, its root cuts the phlegm, and its core digests, and its leaf flows the urine with a flowing’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from al-Sayyariy from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ibn al- Mubarak from abu ‘ Uthman from Durust who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The essence, roots of radish cuts off phlegm, its core helps digest food and its leaves quicken urine fast.’”
